mil5.1.4:0.4: 4. Question On the Shaking of the Earth
mil5.1.4:1.1: “Venerable Nāgasena, this was said by the Blessed One:
mil5.1.4:1.2: ‘Bhikkhus, there are these eight causes and eight conditions for the appearance of a great earthquake.’
mil5.1.4:1.3: This is a statement without remainder, a statement without exception, a statement without alternative—there is no other ninth cause for the appearance of a great earthquake.
mil5.1.4:1.4: If, Venerable Nāgasena, there were another ninth cause for the appearance of a great earthquake, the Blessed One would have stated that cause too.
mil5.1.4:1.5: Since, Venerable Nāgasena, there is no other ninth cause for the appearance of a great earthquake, therefore it was not declared by the Blessed One. But this ninth cause for the appearance of a great earthquake is seen: when King Vessantara was giving the great gift, the great earth shook seven times.
mil5.1.4:1.6: If, Venerable Nāgasena, there are only eight causes and eight conditions for the appearance of a great earthquake, then the statement that when King Vessantara was giving the great gift the great earth shook seven times is false.
mil5.1.4:1.7: If when King Vessantara was giving the great gift the great earth shook seven times, then the statement that there are only eight causes and eight conditions for the appearance of a great earthquake is also false.
